artifact.description: A place with an established, perceivable pattern (three confirmations), then a break. The pattern evidence (place cues) and the gap (ExpectedPatternState) coexist, satisfying the Empty Chair's minimum experiential conditions.
artifact.notes: The 'worn-arrangement' ACCUMULATED_HISTORY cue is the pattern evidence that must coexist with the gap (ABSENCE_EXPECTATION_ARCHITECTURE.md §B6 condition 3) — without it, EXPECTED_BUT_MISSING would be indistinguishable from NEVER_PRESENT. confidence=0.7 after one disconfirmation following three confirmations shows the orthogonal category/confidence split (EV-004): still categorically EXPECTED_BUT_MISSING, confidence only partially weakened.
